narrative.overview:
ninben is named for 亻, the stroke «person» that turned «to move» into jidoka: the loom stops by itself when a thread breaks, and a person decides. The portal is that stop. An aizome-indigo shell runs across the window; under it, a white undyed-cotton page holds one centred reading column. Inside it, one thread runs down the list of what was asked of the signed-in person and breaks exactly where the factory waits for them, with the violet 亻 disc sitting in the gap. Everything else is calm and exact: hairline rules and one hairline panel, small radii, soft state pills, one family, no texture, no fabric imagery, no motion beyond standard hover and focus.

Density is that of a working list, not a dashboard: rows of 56 px or more, a 32 px gap between blocks, a bold page title that leads, text kept to a reading measure. Violet is reserved for what can be touched (actions, links) and for what waits for the person (the stop rows, «N por responder», the «En curso» pill); it never decorates. Every state is said in words inside its pill; the tint and the dot only repeat it.

**Tokens are not this project's to invent.** `brand/ninben.css`, `brand/ninben-components.css`, `brand/logo.svg` and `brand/fonts/` are a generated copy (by `scripts/sync-brand.mjs`) of the single source in the factory repo, `software-factory/design-system/assets/brand/`, shared with the factory's pieces. That source is authoritative for every brand token: colours (light and dark), radius, fonts, the 14/16/20/24 text steps, the spacing scale, the page margin and the shared components. Change a brand token there and sync; never edit the copy in `brand/`. The portal's own tokens live in `css/portal.css`: the reading column, the page title's display size, the shell wordmark's sizes, the three state pills and the thread's two colours.

**Accessibility is the floor.** No sideways scroll and nothing cut from 320 to 1440 px, 48 px controls and 44 px link targets, a visible focus ring on everything that can be touched, axe clean in light and dark, AA text in both schemes and a legible forced-colours rendering. The portal's browser tests measure these; a change that breaks one is a defect, not a design choice.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo shell across the window over a white cotton page; content in a centred reading column of at most 60rem; light and dark from the same roles.
One accent, violet, meaning «you can touch this» or «this waits for you».
The thread: the portal's only signature, drawn on one list only.
States as soft pills with their words and dot: violet in progress, indigo-grey not started, green sent.
Flat: hairline rules, one hairline panel and tinted rows; no shadows for depth.
One family (Figtree, 400/600/700); JetBrains Mono only for the sign-in code.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Violet means «you can touch this» or «this waits for you». A notice is never violet; nothing decorative is violet; the only violet state is «En curso».

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Brand tokens are edited only in the factory's `design-system/assets/brand/` and synced. The portal sets its own tokens only in `css/portal.css`: the reading column, the display size, the shell wordmark, the pills and the thread.

rules.name: The Words In The Pill Rule
rules.body: A state is always said in words inside its pill; the tint and the dot repeat it. Hollow grey ring «Por empezar», ink half-fill «La abrió», ink ring «En curso», green ring «Enviada», green fill «Recibida», struck grey ring «Reemplazada». The portal never uses the base's ink-filled dot: inside the pieces it means «Con observaciones».

rules.name: The Brand Is Not A Heading Rule
rules.body: The wordmark's combination (19 px, 600, tight tracking, on the shell) is never used by a heading, and the page title is always bolder and larger than it.

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: Under the shell, content never runs wider than 60rem, centred; only an embedded piece takes the full frame.

rules.name: The Same Column Rule
rules.body: From 1056 px every list's state lives in the 9rem column, so states line up down the screen.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Hover changes an underline or a border colour, never a shadow or a position.

dos: **Do** take every brand token from the factory's `design-system/assets/brand/` source and sync it; treat `brand/` as generated, and keep the portal's own tokens in `css/portal.css`.
**Do** keep violet for actions, links and what waits for the person, and say every state in words inside its pill.
**Do** keep content in the centred 60rem reading column under the full-width shell, running text at 40rem and forms at 440 px.
**Do** put every list's state in the 9rem column from 1056 px (from 672 px on the owner's entries).
**Do** draw the thread only on «Lo que se te pidió», cut with the 亻 disc at «Por empezar» and «En curso», whole at «Enviada» and «Recibida».
**Do** hold the accessibility floor: no sideways scroll or cut content from 320 to 1440 px, 48 px controls, 44 px links, visible focus, axe clean and AA in light, dark and forced colours.
donts: **Don't** edit `brand/ninben.css` or `brand/ninben-components.css` in the portal, or set a brand token in `css/portal.css`.
**Don't** use shadows for elevation, coloured side stripes on notices, or texture or fabric imagery.
**Don't** use the ink-filled status dot in the portal, or carry a state by colour alone.
**Don't** make a state other than «En curso» violet, or a notice violet.
**Don't** draw the thread on lists about other people (the owner's progress list) or animate it.
**Don't** add a second type family; JetBrains Mono is only for typed figures.
